meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 部署 Python(Flask/Django/FastAPI 等)代码到 Azure App Service Linux。若资源组、计划、Web 应用缺失会创建;设置启动命令和构建开关后部署,完成后打印后续消息并结束回合。
howto.when: 当提到 Flask/Django/FastAPI App Service 等关键词,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: Claude 会创建资源组、计划和 Web 应用并部署。

say.text: 用 azd 部署我的 FastAPI 应用
say.note: 检测到 azure.yaml 时走 azd 流程。

say.text: 部署 Django 到 App Service，运行时用 PYTHON:3.14

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux, creating resource group, plan, and web app if missing. Sets startup command and build flag, deploys, then prints a post-deploy message and ends.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mentions of Flask/Django/FastAPI App Service or a request to deploy Python to App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: It will create resources and deploy.

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI app using azd
say_en.note: Uses azd when azure.yaml is present.
